title: Implement bounded Plan sets and deterministic Plan-pair finalization
goal: Enforce V4-AD-045 limits and implement V4-AD-046 proposal and exact-diff finalization while preserving v1 contracts.
acceptanceCriteria: All accepted Plan-set member byte depth path command entry and time ceilings fail closed with deterministic diagnostics.
Shared path ownership and existing graph union identity and forbidden-boundary violations remain rejected.
Proposal scaffolding writes only non-authoritative EvidenceRoot state.
Finalization requires exact base/head diff reconciliation proposal hash confirmation and source generator policy identities.
Final JSON and Markdown are deterministic matching projections and are not silently adopted into TargetRoot.
risks: Resource enforcement could reinterpret or reject a previously valid ordinary v1 Plan.
Finalization could silently widen planned paths or accept a stale proposal.
decisions: Keep the frozen v1 Plan schemas byte-stable and enforce accepted ceilings in versioned runtime policy.
Write proposal and finalized pair output only below EvidenceRoot for deliberate later adoption.
